pages.useful_because: The homepage tells an Ennis or Waxahachie property owner who D & D Fence is (owned by Austin Dunnahue, 6 years in business, Mon–Fri 7–6, about 25 miles around both towns), which four fence materials it builds plus repair, and how those materials compare on use, look, upkeep and relative cost in one table. It explains a local fact no out-of-area page carries: Ellis County's Blackland Prairie clay swells and shrinks and works fence posts out of line, which is why a leaning section is usually a post problem. It lays out how a job runs from first call to build, answers the six questions owners ask before a new fence, shows the company's real Google reviews, and puts both a quick and a full estimate form on the page.
